AMRPA Operations Tool

Rehab Hospital Service Delivery Dashboard

Generalist vs. Specialist Model

Project Objective

Build an interactive operations model that helps rehab hospitals compare care delivery models, improve patient satisfaction, and strengthen operational effectiveness.

Current Recipe Hybrid triage model

Generalists handle routine cases; specialists support high-complexity patients and escalation paths.

Patient Satisfaction 87 Target: 90+
Avg. Length of Stay 13.2 Target: 12.5 days
Therapist Utilization 81% Target: 78-85%
Readmission Rate 8.4% Target: under 7%

Scenario Inputs

Stakeholder Map

  • Patients and familiesRecovery quality, wait time, communication, safe discharge
  • CliniciansRight patient-provider match, workload balance, outcomes
  • Operations leadersThroughput, staffing efficiency, bed utilization, cost per case
  • PayersValue, appropriate length of stay, lower readmissions
  • AMRPA membersRepeatable scenario tool and clear recommendations

Patient Process Map

Core flow for the rehab hospital model, from patient-in to patient-out.

Stock and flow view
Start Patient In Referral or admission request enters the system
Step 1 Intake and Triage Assess diagnosis, acuity, complexity, payer, and bed availability
Step 2 Care Model Match Assign generalist, specialist, or hybrid care pathway
Step 3 Therapy Delivery Coordinate physician, nursing, therapy, and case management work
Step 4 Progress Review Monitor functional improvement, barriers, delays, and satisfaction
Step 5 Discharge Planning Prepare family, home services, follow-up, and payer documentation
End Patient Out Safe discharge, community transition, or next-care placement
Operational feedback Wait time, utilization, bed capacity, and staffing pressure feed back into intake decisions.
Clinical feedback Functional improvement, readmissions, and satisfaction refine the care model match.

Success KPI Framework

KPIWhy it mattersTarget logic
Patient satisfactionCaptures experience and perceived valueIncrease without harming access
Functional improvementMeasures clinical progress during stayImprove per patient episode
Length of stayBalances recovery time and capacityReduce only when outcomes hold
UtilizationShows staffing efficiency and bottlenecksKeep in productive range
ReadmissionsFlags discharge quality and care mismatchLower through better match quality
